== Description ==
Meet the Farmer!
Season 1 Episode 5

Meet the farmers in Hay Day from all around the world! 

In this 5th episode of the series you'll get to meet Tysha, a devoted Hay Day player living in Oklahoma, US!

Learn how Hay Day has helped her to meet friends, be an active twitter user and enjoy more the company of her lovely pets!
